WITH model_trips AS (
    SELECT m.manufacturer AS manufacturer,
           m.name AS model_name,
           COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count
    FROM model m
    JOIN bike b ON b.model_id = m.model_id
    JOIN trip t ON t.bike_id = b.bike_id
    GROUP BY m.model_id, m.manufacturer, m.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT manufacturer,
           model_name,
           trip_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY manufacturer ORDER BY trip_count DESC, model_name ASC) AS rn
    FROM model_trips
)
SELECT manufacturer, model_name, trip_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY manufacturer ASC, trip_count DESC, model_name ASC;
